description: Every refund_v0 task under two live models from different vendors, five seeds each, every call recorded. Both models accept a seed and have a price in the harness price tables. Temperature is left at each provider's default so each seed samples the model afresh.
budget_note: Proposed cap, awaiting confirmation from Sarp. The expected spend is about $2.50 to $3.20 and the high estimate is $5.60, from the token counts of the eight retained Gemini runs of 13 September and the price tables in models/gemini.py and models/openai.py. docs/live_sweep.md shows the derivation.
